title: BA1/210/2015 of Ram Babu Vs State Of Uttrakhand

paras.text:
BA1 No. 210 of 2015
Hon'ble U.C.Dhyani, J.
 Ms. Pushpa Joshi, Senior Advocate,
assisted by Mr. Saurav Adhikari, Advocate,
present for the applicant.
 Mr. H.O.Bhakuni, AGA, present for the
State.
 Applicant, who is in jail in connection
with FIR No. 531 of 2014, under Sections
379/411 of IPC, registered at Police Station
Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, has
sought his release on bail.
 Heard learned counsel for the parties,
perused the material on record and considered
the grounds taken up in the bail application.
 An FIR was lodged against the unknown
thieves on 03.11.2014 alleging therein that they
broke the windowpane of the informant's car and
took away stealthily cash of Rs. 3 lacs along with
certain papers which were kept in the bag kept
on rear seat of the car.
 Accused-applicant was arrested on
09.12.2014, whereupon a country made pistol
and three live cartridges have been shown to be
recovered from the applicant. Thereafter, while
in custody a sum of Rs. 9000/- were recovered
from his dwelling house. Although the applicant
has a long criminal history, but he is not a
previous convict and is in jail since 09.12.2014.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that
the applicant is ready to furnish reliable sureties
if he is directed to be enlarged on bail.
 Considering the facts as narrated above,
this Court is of the opinion that the applicant
should be granted bail.
 Accordingly, let the applicant Ram Babu
be enlarged on bail on his executing a personal
bond and furnishing two reliable sureties of the
like amount, to the satisfaction of the court
concerned.
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.)
 23.02.2015
 Kaushal
